name: Tumerok Stronghold
title: 40.0S, 54.9W - Tumerok Stronghold
summary: A double Tumerok stronghold on a flat grassy shelf of the East Direlands (40.0S 54.9W). North-east: an open fort of three 5-storey stone spire towers (19 m footprints, 30.75 m tall) in an L at (11340, 14916), (11364, 14892) and (11364, 14916), one with the Dryreach portal and one with a locked chest; south-west: a closed walled compound of low timber halls and plank palisades (5 m) at x 11220-11244, y 14844-14892 holding the Tumerok Gladiators. Wooded hills rise to the north-west.

shots.standingOrder: Fly north 28 m up and 58 m west of the three Tumerok spire towers, the low sun behind the lens, letting them swing through the frame; keep 45 m from the towers and 10 m from the trees.
shots.notes: Signature: lateral fly-by 28 m up, 58 m west of the three 30.75 m Tumerok spire towers, heading north at 8 m/s; the towers swing through the frame and the walled compound slides by in the foreground-left, the low western sun (0.74) behind the camera lighting their stone faces. Subject point = the west tower (its own prism is the subject body).
